map.投入自有资金 200 万、同等风险年收益率 6% → 年机会成本=200×6%=: Putting in 2 million yuan of own capital at a 6% return for equivalent risk gives an annual opportunity cost of 200 × 6% = 120,000 yuan; if the mortgage rate is only 4.2%, borrowing works out better.
map.输入 A=资金 200 万、B=收益率 6% → 总量=A×B=12 万（年机会: With A = capital 2 million and B = return 6%, total = A × B = 120,000 (annual opportunity cost) and difference = A − B = 1.994 million; this is a general two-input estimator.
map.不算现金流支出，但决策时必须计入，否则会高估全款购房的划算程度。: It is not a cash outflow, but it must enter the decision, otherwise paying cash looks better than it really is.
map.取同等风险下可获得的无风险/稳健收益，如理财 3%–4% 或组合 6%–8%，别: Use the risk-free or steady return available at equivalent risk, such as 3%-4% on wealth management products or 6%-8% on a portfolio; do not force a high-risk return into it.

map.资金占用年机会成本（本页代码口径，生效版为页内后定义的专用 calc）：年机会成: Annual opportunity cost of tied-up capital (as coded on this page; the page's later dedicated calc overrides the generic one): annual opportunity cost = A×B÷100 (yuan, A = tied-up capital, B = alternative annual return %); monthly cost = annual÷12; 5-year total = annual×5; opportunity cost rate = annual÷A×100 (%). Validation: if either field is empty a prompt appears and the calculation stops; a non-finite A or B triggers the prompt to enter two valid numbers. Verdict: no fixed grading; higher returns mean more foregone alternative income.
